distribution.reason: Candidate only; actual runtime/source/license and application qualification evidence is pending.

constraints: Linux amd64, glibc 2.41; libfreehsm.so plus the provider-native fhsm-token tool ship in-image and link the base system OpenSSL. Single token in slot 0; token-present index and native slot ID coincide at 0.

The adapter always selects /var/lib/p11lab/freehsm via FHSM_TOKENS_DIR with fixed label P11Lab on slot 0. Token state is slot0.tok plus audit.key; audit.log segments rotate per process and are not byte-stable.

Stock initialization cannot run on trixie (no OpenSSL FIPS provider ships): the adapter sets the documented upstream dev-mode FHSM_INTEGRITY_ALLOW_UNSIGNED=1 FHSM_KAT_ALLOW_FAIL=1 with a PROFILE=interop build. The module self-identifies these runs as token model FreeHSM-TESTMODE. No FIPS claim.

Initialize only an empty writable /var/lib/p11lab volume; module-created audit traces without a token file are the only tolerated pre-existing content. Compatible init is non-destructive; slot0.tok without a marker, foreign files, or a foreign label fail. fhsm-token init refuses an initialized token without --force, which the adapter never passes.

PIN_FILE/SO_PIN_FILE are preferred; scalar alternatives are explicit disposable-test inputs. Conflicting scalar/file or absent/empty credentials fail initial provisioning. PINs reach fhsm-token through its documented environment inputs only, never argv.

Runtime controls are recreated under writable /run/p11lab by every invocation. The adapter preserves argv and native/application exit status. Health opens the real token with the pinned stock fhsm-token and asserts the P11Lab label.
Ordinary application consumers do not require checker, Python, tracing or a workspace mount. Reset is an explicit removal/replacement of disposable state; no automatic reset or retry.
Whole-image licensing, source companion delivery and digest-bound admission remain separate requirements.
